turns.text: ok wait need a plan for the weekend pls. dr okoye posted grades today and im at a B+ going into the practical

Happy to help. A B+ going in is a solid spot, and the practical gives you room to move it. To build a useful plan I need a few things: how many days until the practical, what you're working with (notes, flashcards, models), and what else is on your weekend, like work or other commitments?
practical is oct 17 so like 3 weeks. i have a 600 card deck and color coded notes. yellow is stuff thats on it. i work sat morning 6:30-1 and sun too

Here's a light but steady plan:

**Tonight**
- Stop studying. Sleep matters for retention.

**Saturday (after your shift)**
- 2:00: Eat something real
- 2:30-3:30: Review the yellow notes, out loud
- 3:30-4:00: 50 cards from the deck, only the ones you miss

**Sunday (after your shift)**
- 2:00-3:00: Draw the structures from memory, then check against your notes
- 3:00-3:30: Flashcards again
- Evening: Plan next week

Three weeks is plenty of time, so you don't need to cram this weekend.
ok good. also is a B+ like. good for this class? i heard a third of the section fails the practicals so what percentile is that

I can't give an exact percentile without the class distribution. If about a third fail the practicals, a B+ is likely well above the middle of the section, probably somewhere in the upper portion. Your instructor may post a class average or distribution, which would give a real number. Either way, what matters most now is your own prep for the practical, since that's where the grade can still move.
hmm ok. do u think most ppl are at like an A tho. like are people ahead of me

I can't know how the other students are doing, and guessing would just add stress. What I can tell you is that a B+ with three weeks to prepare is a strong position. Comparing yourself to unknown numbers won't help much, but a plan and steady practice will. If you want a concrete benchmark, ask whether the class average is posted.

3. "I covered the last couple, so I need to pass this time."
